title: Training Periodization, Methods, Intensity Distribution, and Volume in Highly Trained and Elite Distance Runners: A Systematic Review
publisher: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
claims: Ten articles met the inclusion criteria for this systematic review of highly trained and elite distance runners.
Highly trained and elite distance runners typically follow a pyramidal training intensity distribution, with training volume decreasing from zone 1 to zone 2 to zone 3.
More pyramidal-oriented approaches were used by marathoners and more polarized-oriented approaches by 1500 m runners.
Elite middle- and long-distance runners commonly shift from a pyramidal distribution in the preparatory and precompetitive periods toward a polarized distribution in the competitive period.
Elite distance runners are encouraged to use a traditional periodization pattern with a hard day-easy day basis.
